faces.name: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex
faces.oracleText:
Menace
When Vona de Iedo enters, destroy target nonland, nontoken permanent an opponent controls. Then you may discard a card. If you do, conjure a duplicate of that permanent into your hand, and the duplicate perpetually gains prismatic.

faces.name: Vona's Hunger
faces.oracleText:
Ascend (If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.)
Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice. If you have the city's blessing, instead each opponent sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up.
